audit_member_text: Use-before-local-assignment / implicit interface: g4 through g10 are first referenced on lines 36-42 and t is first referenced on line 69; their only possible source in this file is the unstructured workspace import load('C.mat') on line 2, so their presence, shapes, and correspondence cannot be established from the script.

Range coupling: both loops use length(n4) as the bound (lines 14 and 25) while indexing n5 through n10 on lines 16-21 and 27-32; any shorter station array causes out-of-range indexing, and extra rows in longer arrays are left untransformed.

Range coupling: lines 35-42 index every g-series at 1:600 without checking that g4 through g10 each contain at least 600 elements; later plot calls on lines 69-99 additionally require each g-series length to match t.
Copy/paste no-op: the complete loop on lines 25-33 assigns every second column element to itself and has no effect.

Cross-series transform asymmetry: n4/g4 through n9/g9 receive paired vertical offsets on lines 47-63, but the analogous n10/g10 offset statements are commented on lines 65-66 while that pair is still plotted on lines 99-101; whether the unshifted final pair is intentional is not stated.

The loaded station first columns are divided by 10 and shifted (lines 15-21) while loaded g amplitudes are multiplied by 100 (lines 36-42); the source units of the imported arrays are not declared in this file, so the plotted axis labels cannot independently validate these conversions.
